items.html: And this is the secret of those two prophets called Eldad and Medad, who suckled from the two breasts of the lower Nukva, the Nukva of ZA. And Eldad (Aleph-Lamed-Dalet-Dalet) is the Aleph, for the right breast, joined with the Aleph-Lamed of Elokim, becomes 'El Dad'. And Medad (Mem-Yud-Dalet-Dalet) is the left breast, joined with the Mi of Elokim, becoming 'Mi Dad'.
